ablation_semantics.Full: Original typed transition and measured-state decoder.
ablation_semantics.NoGraph: A channel is zero at input, every transition and decoder; graph-target loss is zero. Market state is retained, including its residual-dependence summary. This does not remove every graph-derived statistic.
ablation_semantics.SingleSigned: All transition coordinates use the signed Laplacian; decoder risk masking and registered financial concept definitions remain unchanged.
ablation_semantics.SingleUnsigned: All transition coordinates use the unsigned Laplacian; decoder risk masking and registered financial concept definitions remain unchanged.
ablation_semantics.NoStateSupervision: Both forward concept and graph target-loss coefficients are zero; the forward state architecture remains unchanged.

definitions.point_metrics: Six headline metrics from complete.json; means and sample SD over separately trained seeds. RMSE computed per run before seed aggregation.
definitions.paired_effect: candidate variant minus Full; positive loss difference favors Full
definitions.paired_unit: One chronological origin contains all assets and all five leads; average paired losses across matched seeds before temporal resampling. Seeds are never independent time observations.
definitions.bootstrap: paired circular block bootstrap; 5000 draws by default; percentile95%CI and centered-null two-sided p
definitions.multiple_testing: Holm correction over all four non-Full variants, separately for MSE and ES within each fold and block length. Missing variants receive p=1 in diagnostic correction; MAE is unadjusted.
definitions.concept_MAE: Stored standardized projected concept MAE per lead/coordinate, averaged over origins and assets; h=0 excluded. Overall coordinate MAE uses equal weights over the five leads.
definitions.graph_IoU: Strict abs(A_ij)>0.05 on off-diagonal entries, per-origin intersection/union then mean over origins. Empty union is zero; h=0 excluded.
definitions.graph_MAE: Mean absolute off-diagonal edge-weight error, per future lead.
definitions.energy_score_source: exact float64 recomputation from complete scenarios

precision.energy_score: exact finite-scenario U-statistic recomputed in float64 from original full test scenarios
